sources.instructions: Install the owned original Subnautica version required by the selected official Nitrox release and set SUBNAUTICA_INSTALLATION_PATH. Use a complete installation, not Below Zero or DLLs from arbitrary download sites. Current Nitrox supports newer game builds; do not universally force a legacy branch.

manual_reason: Manual full-distribution staging is required. These known file sentinels do not establish completeness; inspect the game-specific source instructions.
